title: ToXCL: A Unified Framework for Toxic Speech Detection and Explanation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to detect implicit toxic speech and generate text explanations for posts targeting specific racial or ethnic groups (e.g., Black, Asian, White people) using classification metrics (Accuracy, F1) and text generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, human evaluation) on the Implicit Hate Corpus and Social Bias Inference Corpus.

Assessing the model's performance in classifying and explaining implicit hate speech directed at religious groups (e.g., Muslims, Jewish people) using automated n-gram/embedding metrics and human evaluation.
Measuring the detection accuracy and explanation generation quality for implicit misogynistic or sexist speech targeting women.
Evaluating the framework's capability to detect and correctly explain implicitly toxic or stereotypical comments directed at political groups (e.g., liberals).
Measuring the model's effectiveness in identifying and explaining implicit hate speech targeting immigrants and estimating the underlying xenophobic intent.
